description.detail: Authored eval/design.json as the evaluation contract rather than hardcoded copy: two modes, five gates with question, files read, pass and fail conditions, the seed and determinism rules, link-prediction split, negatives, seeds, bootstrap, arms and models, and an eight-step iteration loop. A new tests/test_eval_design.py checks every emitted suite has a gate, that modes reference real gates, and that constants match eval/common.py and eval/link_prediction.py. The design RPC returned format kg-eval-design, 5 gates, 2 modes, seed 1729, link seeds 0-4, arms static/enriched/pruned, 8 iteration steps; the suite ran 55 tests.
description.numbers: 2 modes (quick 4 gates, full 5); 5 gates; seed 1729; link seeds 0-4; 5 negatives per positive; bootstrap 200; test ratio 0.2; 8 iteration steps; 55 tests passed
description.status: built and guarded by contract tests; commit bf8114d
